about: W2-A3 golden corpus: model-output arg shapes -> the args UCT accepts (api/services/uct_agent/args.py), or an explicit refusal. Scored by tests/test_uct_agent_args_corpus.py against app/src/agent/contract/manifest.golden.json schemas. Seeded from the Phase 1 live failures (LT-3, 2026-11-03) and the catalog hints. No market values.

sources.catalog-hint: the capability's own hints in manifest.golden.json
sources.model-shape: shapes small models write (measured 2026-10-08 and since)
